content.text: DONE — body id 433 (`enclosure-lid`): 80 × 50 × 2 mm plate with R3 corners on z = 25–27, a solid 1.5 mm lip at 0.2 mm clearance per side, and four Ø3.4 through holes with Ø6.3 × 90° countersinks on the boss axes; read-back confirms the dimensions and no interference with base 422. The Ø3.4/Ø6.3 M3 sizing is my choice from the Ø2.5 pilots, and four countersink profile wires (436, 439, 442, 445) remain in the document.
